facts: GLA describes SHLAA as a technical exercise on land potentially available for housing development
GLA explicitly states SHLAA is not a site allocations exercise
Its purpose is an aggregate housing-capacity evidence base at local-authority level
The London-wide SHLAA informs borough housing targets in the London Plan
The 2017 page publishes approval and allocation site appendices
The page publishes GIS shape files of approval/allocation site boundaries
Potential sites remain confidential according to the page
The dataset is one-off and substantially older than current borough plan services
SHLAA evidence cannot substitute for current borough-confirmed site-allocation membership
No future-growth score is promoted solely from SHLAA context or historical approval/allocation records
